name: Agreement
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of agreement as a foundation for unity and effective prayer. From the unified language of humanity in Genesis 11:1 to the early church's harmony at Pentecost in Acts 2:1, agreement fosters fellowship and spiritual power. Jesus highlights that two agreeing in prayer will receive answers from the Father (Matthew 18:19), underscoring the necessity of clear, honest communication (Matthew 5:37) and alignment in purpose (Amos 3:3). This principle extends to practical relationships, such as prenuptial agreements, where mutual understanding and accord are essential.
